$comment: Graph campaign fixture (#192). NOT CONTENT: it lives outside content/ so neither the loader nor content:validate ever sees it, and nothing ships it. Its chapter ids are placeholders with no files behind them. It exists to show every part of the declaration once - a branch, a sideways move, a return edge closing a cycle, a guarded edge, a locked edge and its unlock, a once edge, an irreversible claim, a variant, each revisit policy, and two endings - and campaign-graph.test.ts and tools/content/campaign-graph-schema.test.mjs hold it to the schema and the parser. docs/campaigns/graph-campaigns.md walks through it.
title: The Rift Sampler
blurb: A waystone, an orchard, a mill and a quarry, and two ways for the evening to end. Not a story: a map of every kind of path.

waystone.$comment: The hub. Played once; every return afterwards walks straight through to the exit choice.
waystone.title: The Waystone

orchard.$comment: Replayed on return, and once the mill wheel turns the orchard is a different chapter (a different biome: flooded).
orchard.title: The Orchard

mill.$comment: Closed once completed: the wheel only needs starting once.
mill.title: The Old Mill

to-quarry.$comment: The quarry road washes out behind the party: one crossing per attempt.
to-quarry.label: Up the quarry road

orchard-to-mill.label: Along the stream to the mill

mill-to-orchard.$comment: Starting the wheel floods the orchard and opens the tower door; the way back closes the orchard-mill cycle.
mill-to-orchard.label: Back to the orchard

orchard-to-tower.$comment: Seen from the start, so the party knows the door is there; opened by the mill.
orchard-to-tower.label: Through the tower door

quarry-to-tower.$comment: Guarded: only a party whose quarry chapter found the lens knows the climb exists. Hidden otherwise.
quarry-to-tower.label: Climb to the tower

quarry-to-home.$comment: Offered only after a quarry setback: the early, gentler ending.
quarry-to-home.label: Take the long road home
